resources.string:
Open Instagram DMs directly, without browsing the feed or endless Reels.

Sign in on Instagram’s website. The developer does not store your conversations or passwords on a separate server.

Use Notifications to relay DM alerts from the official Instagram app. Calls are not guaranteed to work.
Enable DirectOnly notifications and the DM notification channel first.
Skipped: not identified as a DM
Notification relay is off. You can also revoke notification access in Android settings.
Original DM notifications are hidden only after DirectOnly sends an alert.
Original notifications will also remain visible.

Android notification access is a broad permission that can expose notifications from other apps. DirectOnly processes only the Instagram package and identifies DMs by notification type and channel. It does not store message bodies or send them to a developer server.

Sign in to the same account in Instagram and DirectOnly. With multiple accounts, the inbox may differ.

Allow “DirectOnly · Instagram DM notification relay” on the next screen. Android may restrict this setting depending on how the app was installed.
Find Notification access in your phone settings and allow DirectOnly.
DM alerts need notification permission. You can enable it from Notifications.
The DM screen is taking longer to prepare. Tap Refresh.
Could not connect. Check your internet connection and tap Refresh.
Could not verify the secure connection. The connection was stopped.
This link cannot be opened in the app.
This clears the login session and web data stored by this app.

An unofficial DM-focused web client, not affiliated with Instagram.

Messaging depends on Instagram’s web support. Instagram updates may require changes to the navigation filters.

DM alerts relay notifications from the official Instagram app. They cannot work if the original notification is missing or blocked by the system. Voice and video calls are not guaranteed.
Alerts you to new Instagram DMs and opens them in DirectOnly.
You have a new Instagram DM
Tap to open your DMs in DirectOnly.

Relay DM alerts received by the official Instagram app to DirectOnly. Keep Instagram signed in with DM notifications enabled.
